test_case_name: Accept All Cookies and Navigate to Investor Relations

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies on the parent page
Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
And then check that the Investor Relations page is displayed

test_case_name: Open Cookie Options on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click the 'Più opzioni' link to open cookie options on the parent page
Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link to open cookie options on the child page
And then check that the cookie options are displayed on the child page

test_case_name: Accept Cookies on Both Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies on the parent page
Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'ACCONSENTO' link to accept cookies on the child page
And then check that the cookie banner is closed on the child page

test_case_name: Search for Information on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click the 'Search' button to open the search input on the parent page
Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search input on the parent page
Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' to open the search input on the child page
Type $name into the 'Cerca' search input on the child page
Click the button with class 'btn-search' and data-name 'search-button' to submit the search on the child page
And then check that the search results are displayed on the child page

test_case_name: Access User Area and Attempt Login on Investor Relations Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'AREA UTENTE' button to open the user area dropdown
Click the 'Accedi' button to attempt login
And then check that the login form or authentication prompt is displayed

test_case_name: Switch Language to English on Investor Relations Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'EN' link to switch the language to English
And then check that the Investor Relations page is displayed in English

test_case_name: Navigate to 'IR Policy' from Parent to Child Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'IR Policy' link in the aside menu
And then check that the IR Policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Open and Close Cookie Banner on Both Pages

intents.intent: Click the button with id 'cookie-chiudi' to close the cookie banner on the parent page
Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the button with id 'js-cookie-banner-close' to close the cookie banner on the child page
And then check that the cookie banner is closed on the child page

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Comunicati stampa' Tab and View All Press Releases

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'COMUNICATI STAMPA' button to select the press releases tab
Click the 'Leggi tutti i comunicati stampa' link to view all press releases
And then check that the full list of press releases is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Bilanci e Relazioni' Tab and View All Reports

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'BILANCI E RELAZIONI' button to select the reports tab
Click the 'Leggi tutti i bilanci e relazioni' link to view all reports
And then check that the full list of reports is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Presentazioni' Tab and View All Presentations

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'PRESENTAZIONI' button to select the presentations tab
Click the 'Leggi tutte le presentazioni' link to view all presentations
And then check that the full list of presentations is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Contatti' from User Area Dropdown

intents.intent: Click the 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the Investor Relations site
Click the 'AREA UTENTE' button to open the user area dropdown
Click the 'Contatti' link in the user area dropdown
And then check that the contacts page is displayed
